page_description: Status, savings and restore access for the PEB backup gateway.
tiles_footnote: Based on {{count}} backups. Price {{price}} per TB and month. Repository size measured {{time}}.
tiles_approx_note: The repository size is approximate because the repository is remote: it counts the data referenced by snapshots, not the occupied disk space.
prune_disabled: Pruning is disabled on the gateway.
chart_empty: No data yet. The charts fill once backups have been received.
chart_daily: Per day: backup size and actually new data
forecast_full: The repository has reached its configured capacity
forecast_unknown: Not enough measurements for a forecast yet
filter_servers: Filter by name, owner, node or UUID
servers_empty: No server has sent a backup to the gateway yet.
servers_attention: {{count}} server(s) need attention: no successful backup in the last {{hours}} hours, a failed last backup, or no backup yet.
health_overdue_hint: The last successful backup is older than {{hours}} hours.
health_failed_hint: The most recent backup of this server failed.
health_never_hint: This server has never completed a backup.
no_server_context: This tab is only available on a server's page.
download_hint: A download is restored from the repository and streamed through the panel. Large files can take a while to start.
index_truncated: The file index of this backup is incomplete (index limit reached). Only part of the files is listed; a download of an unlisted file still searches the archive.
maintenance_intro: The gateway prunes unused data, checks the repository and refreshes the size statistics every night. New backups wait while prune or check holds the repository.
maintenance_empty: No maintenance jobs have run yet.
maintenance_running: A maintenance run is in progress. This page refreshes automatically.
maintenance_busy: A maintenance run is already active.
run_confirm_text: While the jobs run, the repository is locked: new backups and restores wait until they finish, or give up after 15 minutes. Choose the jobs to run:
job_prune_hint: Remove data that no snapshot references any more and free space.
job_stats_hint: Refresh the repository size used by the dashboard.
error_title: The gateway data could not be loaded
error_not_configured: The gateway is not configured yet. Set the gateway URL and admin token under Admin > Extensions > PEB Backups.
error_gateway_unreachable: The gateway is not reachable from the panel server. Check that the gateway server is running and that the URL in the extension settings is correct.
error_gateway_timeout: The gateway did not answer in time.
error_gateway_unauthorized: The gateway rejected the admin token. Check the token in the extension settings.
error_api_disabled: The admin API is switched off on the gateway. Set PEB_ADMIN_TOKEN on the gateway and restart it.
error_gateway_invalid_response: The gateway sent an answer the extension cannot read.
error_busy: The gateway is busy (maintenance or all restore slots in use). Try again in a few minutes.
error_not_found: The backup or file was not found.
error_not_complete: This backup is not complete, so its files cannot be browsed.
error_network: The panel could not be reached. Check your connection.
error_session: Your panel session has expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
tip_logical: Space all backups would need without PEB (uncompressed, no deduplication)
tip_stored: What is actually stored on the backup target
tip_saved: Difference of logical size ({{logical}}) and actually stored ({{stored}})
tip_factor: {{factor}}× means backups need {{factor}} times less space than without deduplication
tip_money: Space saved at the configured price of {{price}} per TB and month
tip_col_added_server: What the last backup really added to storage after deduplication
tip_col_logical_backup: Space this backup would need without PEB (uncompressed, no deduplication)
tip_col_added_backup: Data this backup really added to storage after deduplication
cols_help: Size: size of the last backup (uncompressed). Data added: what the last backup really added to storage after deduplication. Stored: space all backups of the server occupy on the target. Hover a value for details.
tip_col_stored_server: Space on the backup target used by this server's backups (compressed, deduplicated). Data shared with other servers counts for each of them, so the column sum can exceed the total.
target_empty: Free space on the backup target is not known yet. It appears after the next statistics refresh, or set the capacity in the gateway for remote targets.
target_bar: Used and free space on the backup target
target_full_unknown: Full in: not enough growth data for an estimate
target_room_unknown: Room for more backups: no recent backups to base an estimate on
tip_target_exact: Total and free space are measured on the backup target. The estimates assume the recent growth continues: days until full from the repository's growth, remaining backups from the free space divided by the average new data per backup of the last 30 days.
tip_target_estimate: The target size is configured, not measured, so free space is estimated as capacity minus repository size and other data on the target is not visible. The estimates assume the recent growth continues (average new data per backup of the last 30 days).
pro_retention_hint: Retention policies (keep daily, weekly, monthly …) with preview are part of PEB Backups Pro.
pro_retention_hint_server: Per-server retention policies with a preview of what would be kept or deleted are part of PEB Backups Pro.
tip_col_limit: Backups of this server in the panel (running and successful) against its backup limit. At the limit, only scheduled backups rotate out the oldest unlocked backup. Manual backups are refused.
setup_description: Check the panel backup configuration, set up the gateway and test the connection. Nothing is written to your .env automatically.
setup_load_error: The setup state could not be loaded
setup_precheck_intro: This is how the panel is configured for backups right now. Secrets are never shown, only whether they are set.
setup_precheck_ready: The panel is ready to send backups to the gateway.
setup_precheck_not_ready: Some settings are missing. Use the steps below and the .env block to fix them.
setup_check_credentials: Bucket, access key and secret are set
setup_check_gateway_url: Gateway URL is set in the extension settings
setup_check_admin_token: Admin token is set in the extension settings
setup_check_s3: Signed S3 request with the panel credentials
setup_fix_endpoint_missing: Set AWS_ENDPOINT to the gateway address in the panel .env.
setup_fix_path_style_off: Set AWS_USE_PATH_STYLE_ENDPOINT=true in the panel .env. The gateway only speaks path-style.
setup_fix_credentials_missing: Set AWS_BACKUPS_BUCKET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in the panel .env.
setup_fix_part_size_invalid: BACKUP_MAX_PART_SIZE is not a positive number. Recommended: 268435456 (256 MiB).
setup_fix_part_size_small: Very small parts mean very many requests per backup. Recommended: BACKUP_MAX_PART_SIZE=268435456 (256 MiB).
setup_fix_part_size_large: The gateway rejects parts above PEB_MAX_PART_BYTES (default 1 GiB). Set BACKUP_MAX_PART_SIZE=268435456 (256 MiB).
setup_fix_gateway_url_missing: Enter the gateway base URL under Admin > Extensions > PEB Backups.
setup_fix_admin_token_missing: Enter the value of PEB_ADMIN_TOKEN under Admin > Extensions > PEB Backups.
setup_fix_gateway_unreachable: The panel server cannot reach the gateway. Check that the gateway server is running, the address and port in the extension settings, and firewalls.
setup_fix_gateway_timeout: The gateway did not answer in time. Check the network path and whether the gateway is overloaded.
setup_fix_gateway_not_peb: Something answered, but it is not the PEB gateway (no healthy /healthz). Check the address, port and any proxy in between.
setup_fix_gateway_first: Not tested because the gateway could not be reached. Fix the previous step first.
setup_fix_token_rejected: The gateway rejected the token. Compare the extension setting with PEB_ADMIN_TOKEN of the gateway server.
setup_fix_api_disabled: The admin API is off. Set PEB_ADMIN_TOKEN (at least 32 characters) on the gateway server and restart it.
setup_fix_no_s3_disk: The panel does not use the S3 backup driver. Set APP_BACKUP_DRIVER=s3 and the AWS_* values in the panel .env, then clear the config cache.
setup_fix_s3_denied: The gateway rejected the signature. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION must match PEB_ACCESS_KEY, PEB_SECRET_KEY and PEB_REGION, and the gateway must be reachable under exactly the address in AWS_ENDPOINT.
setup_fix_s3_unreachable: The panel cannot reach AWS_ENDPOINT. Check the address, the port and firewalls.
setup_fix_s3_timeout: AWS_ENDPOINT did not answer in time.
setup_fix_s3_error: The endpoint answered with an error. Check that AWS_BACKUPS_BUCKET matches PEB_BUCKET and look at the gateway log.
setup_fix_s3_abort_failed: The test upload was created but could not be aborted. It may still occupy a little spool space on the gateway.
setup_fix_not_https: At least one address uses plain HTTP. Browser downloads of backups need HTTPS when the panel is served over HTTPS (mixed content). Put the gateway behind a TLS proxy.
setup_egg_intro: Imports the PEB Gateway egg that ships with this extension, using the panel own importer.
setup_egg_missing: The egg is not in the panel yet.
setup_egg_exists: The egg already exists (ID {{id}}). Update it to the bundled version instead of importing a duplicate.
setup_egg_failed: The egg could not be imported. Check the panel log.
setup_egg_error: The bundled egg could not be read ({{code}}). Reinstall the extension.
setup_manual_egg_title: Egg import is not available in this panel version
setup_manual_egg: Do it by hand: download egg/egg-peb-gateway.json from the project repository and import it under Admin > Eggs > Import.
setup_server_intro: Creates a server from the egg. Access key, secret, admin token and restic password are generated here and shown once.
setup_manual_server_title: Server creation is not available in this panel version
setup_manual_server: Do it by hand: create a server from the PEB Gateway egg, set the egg variables (S3 access key and secret, bucket, restic password, admin token of at least 32 characters) and set the backup limit to 0.
setup_field_repository_hint: Path or URL of the restic repository, for example a mounted directory. Empty uses the default inside the server data.
setup_no_allocations: This node has no free allocation. Create one under Admin > Nodes > Allocation.
setup_server_failed: The server could not be created.
setup_error_wings_unreachable: The panel could not reach Wings on that node, so nothing was created.
setup_error_allocation_unavailable: The allocation is no longer free.
setup_error_egg_missing: The egg does not exist yet. Import it first.
setup_created_text: Server {{name}} was created and is installing.
setup_secrets_warning: They are shown only once here. They are also saved as egg variables of the new server (in plain text in the panel database), so the server owner and subusers with startup permission can see them under Server > Startup. The restic password is the key to all backups: without it they cannot be restored.
setup_secret_admin_token: Admin token (enter it in the extension settings)
setup_gateway_address: Gateway address: {{url}}. Put a TLS proxy in front for HTTPS and use that address instead.
setup_snippets_intro: Add the block to the panel .env and the snippet to the Wings config.yml, then restart as usual. Nothing is written for you.
setup_snippets_placeholders: Values in angle brackets are placeholders. Create the gateway server above to get real values.
setup_selftest_intro: Checks the gateway, the admin token and a signed S3 request made with the panel credentials (a test upload that is aborted again).
setup_selftest_failed: At least one check failed. See the hints.
setup_selftest_error: The self-test could not be run.
setup_server_maybe_exists: The server may already exist (the answer can get lost, or a retry hit the allocation again). Its values are under Server > Startup (egg variables). Check the server list before trying again.
setup_owner_note: Only root administrators can be the owner: the owner can read the generated secrets.
setup_field_host_hint: Host name or IP under which the panel and Wings reach the gateway. Used when the allocation has no IP alias; 0.0.0.0 and :: are not valid. Prefilled with the node FQDN.
setup_error_egg_outdated: The egg in the panel is outdated and lacks variables. Update the egg first (step 2).
setup_error_host_required: Enter a valid gateway address (not 0.0.0.0 or ::).
setup_egg_update_note: Updating overwrites changes made to the egg in the panel.
offsite_off_hint: A second copy of all backups at another location protects against losing the main target.
offsite_warn_lag: {{count}} snapshot(s) have not been copied for more than 24 hours. The offsite copy is behind.
offsite_copy_busy: An offsite copy is already running.
offsite_warn_failed: The last copy failed. The offsite copy may be out of date.
offsite_warn_forget_blocked: Mirroring deleted backups to the offsite copy is stopped by a safety check and nothing is deleted there. See the error below and the gateway documentation for how to release it.
offsite_warn_prune_skipped: Pruning the main repository was skipped {{count}} times in a row because the repository was busy. No space is freed until it runs.
password_banner_title: Is your restic password stored in a second place?
password_banner_text: All backups are encrypted with the restic password of the gateway. If it is lost, every backup is lost for good, and nobody can recover it for you. Store it in a password manager or print the emergency sheet and write it on paper.
password_banner_ack: I have stored the password in a second place
password_ok_text: Restic password confirmed as stored in a second place{{who}}{{when}}.
password_ack_failed: The confirmation could not be saved.
sheet_failed: The emergency sheet could not be created.
sheet_popup_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
sheet_intro: This sheet lets you restore backups without the gateway and without the panel. Keep it in a safe place, separate from the server. The restic password is not printed here on purpose: write it in the box below by hand, or store it in a password manager.
sheet_repo_note: Credentials of the repository are not shown. Take them from the gateway settings (environment of the gateway server).
sheet_offsite_rclone: This repository is reached through rclone. Install rclone and keep its configuration (for Google Drive the file rclone.conf with the token) together with this sheet, otherwise restic cannot open the repository.
sheet_password: Restic password (write it here by hand)
sheet_password_hint: Do not type the password into a file next to this sheet. Anyone with the password and the repository can read all backups.
sheet_restore_step_env: Set the password (or enter it when restic asks):
sheet_restore_step_list: List the snapshots of a server:
sheet_restore_step_dump: Write a snapshot as a tar archive:
sheet_restore_step_restore: Or restore its files into a folder:
sheet_restore_note: Replace <server-uuid> with the UUID from the list below and <snapshot> with the ID of the snapshot you want. The archive is the server backup file <server-uuid>.tar; with restore it ends up as <target>/<server-uuid>.tar.
sheet_print_hint: Print this page (Ctrl+P) or save it as PDF.
keys_intro: A second restic key opens the same repository with a different password. Give it to your hosting provider or store it in a safe, so a lost main password does not mean lost backups. The gateway does not store the new password.
keys_created_warning: This password is shown only once. Copy it now and store it safely. It cannot be shown again.
keys_create_failed: The key could not be created.
keys_delete_text: Whoever holds the password of key {{id}} can no longer open the repository with it. This cannot be undone.
keys_delete_failed: The key could not be deleted.
keys_unsupported: This gateway does not support key management yet. Update the gateway to 0.2.0 or later.
setup_password_hint: Store the restic password in a second place right away (password manager or paper). Afterwards, open the emergency sheet in the dashboard and confirm it there.
trash_intro: Backups deleted in the panel, and the backups of deleted servers, wait here before they are removed for good. The panel no longer knows them, but you can still restore a backup (then it is a normal gateway backup again and you can browse and download its files here; it does not reappear in the panel) or delete it now.
trash_purge_text: The backup is forgotten in the repository right away. Disk space is freed by the next prune. This cannot be undone.
